test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: **Convert to indirect speech:** He said, “Do it right now.”

options.text: He told to do it now.
He told me to do it at once.
He told me do it right now.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an **imperative sentence** (a command): “Do it right now.”
 
• In indirect speech, commands are reported using the reporting verb **told** + **object** + **to + verb**.
 
• The phrase **“right now”** changes to **“at once”** or “immediately” in indirect speech.
 
• Thus, the correct conversion is: **He told me to do it at once.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *“He told me to do it at once.”*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: He said do it immediately.** – Incorrect; missing object after “said”. Should be “said to me”. Also not in proper indirect form.
 
• **Option 2: He told to do it now.** – Incorrect; missing object (“me”), and “now” should change in indirect speech.
 
• **Option 4: He told me to do it ****right now****.** – Incorrect; “right now” changes to 'at once' or 'immediately'.
